description: Data layer: Alembic migrations, ORM updates, and new utility modules that all later features depend on. Covers Task 4 (HashChain service), Task 7 (privacy.py scrub function), Task 1 migration (corridor_min/corridor_max on auctions table), Task 5 migration (advance_amount/holdback_amount/escrow_status on escrow_pos table), EscrowPORecord ORM column additions. Independent of FEAT-002 and FEAT-003.
steps: 1. Create worker/src/services/hash_chain.py with HashChain class. Constructor seeds head = sha256(b'GENESIS').hexdigest(). append(frame: TelemetryFrame) -> str: serialise frame as json.dumps(frame.model_dump(mode='json'), sort_keys=True), compute new_head = sha256((self.head + payload_json).encode()).hexdigest(), store as self.head, return it. Expose head property. No external dependencies beyond hashlib and json.

2. Create worker/src/agents/privacy.py with: _GSTIN_RE = re.compile(r'[0-9]{2}[A-Z]{5}[0-9]{4}[A-Z]{1}[1-9A-Z]{1}Z[0-9A-Z]{1}'). def scrub(text: str, org_id: str = '') -> str: return _GSTIN_RE.sub('[GSTIN-REDACTED]', text). def scrub_dict(data: dict, org_id: str = '') -> dict: return json.loads(scrub(json.dumps(data), org_id)).

3. Create packages/synthetiq-shared/alembic/versions/f1a2b3c4d5e6_phase5_bids_corridor.py. revision='f1a2b3c4d5e6', down_revision='e7f8a9b0c1d2'. upgrade(): op.add_column('auctions', sa.Column('corridor_min', sa.Float(), nullable=True)); op.add_column('auctions', sa.Column('corridor_max', sa.Float(), nullable=True)). downgrade() reverses.

4. Create packages/synthetiq-shared/alembic/versions/g2b3c4d5e6f7_phase5_escrow_split.py. revision='g2b3c4d5e6f7', down_revision='f1a2b3c4d5e6'. upgrade(): op.add_column('escrow_pos', sa.Column('advance_amount', sa.Float(), nullable=True)); op.add_column('escrow_pos', sa.Column('holdback_amount', sa.Float(), nullable=True)); op.add_column('escrow_pos', sa.Column('escrow_status', sa.String(32), nullable=True, server_default='advance_pending')). downgrade() reverses.

5. In packages/synthetiq-shared/synthetiq_shared/models/organization.py, add to EscrowPORecord class: advance_amount: Mapped[float | None] = mapped_column(Float, nullable=True); holdback_amount: Mapped[float | None] = mapped_column(Float, nullable=True); escrow_status: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(32), default='advance_pending'). Update to_dict() to include advance_amount, holdback_amount, escrow_status.

6. Create worker/tests/__init__.py (empty). Create worker/tests/test_privacy.py with two pytest test functions: test_scrub_removes_gstin asserts '[GSTIN-REDACTED]' in scrub('27AAACH1234F1Z5', ''); test_scrub_passthrough asserts scrub('hello world', '') == 'hello world'. Import from agents.privacy (add sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).parent.parent / 'src')) at top of test file).
acceptance_criteria: cd worker && python -m pytest tests/test_privacy.py -v passes both tests
python -c 'import sys; sys.path.insert(0,"worker/src"); from services.hash_chain import HashChain; print(ok)' prints ok
cd packages/synthetiq-shared && alembic upgrade head completes without error showing f1a2b3c4d5e6 and g2b3c4d5e6f7
EscrowPORecord in organization.py has advance_amount, holdback_amount, escrow_status attributes
